svg.text: ROCm 7.14 · Speculative-depth eight versus the four-agent baseline
What / how to read: A/B of a wider draft setting under the same deep four-agent load. The wider draft is expected to consume more KV and verification work; evaluate KV
capacity, ITL tail and throughput, not only average decode.
PP unavailable: completion-credited counter bursts are diagnostic only, not sustained prefill throughput.
